permanent:
Permanent orienteering courses have been set up in a number of forests and country parks across the region. They provide an excellent opportunity to practise without the pressure of an event.

The controls are usually marked by a wooden post with a small red and white square.

Maps are either available to download from our website or purchase from a visitor's centre. The map shows all the controls, with suggested sequences to offer courses of differing lengths and levels of navigational difficulty.

maprun: MapRun is a free app that turns your phone into a virtual orienteering control system. Download a course, head to the start and follow the map. The app uses GPS to register each control as you reach it, and your result is uploaded automatically. Courses are open at any time, so you can go whenever suits you.
maprunnew:
What you need

  • A smartphone with the MapRun app (or a Garmin watch with the MapRunG app).

  • The course map, printed out or on your screen.

How to do a course

  1. Choose a course from the list on the MapRun page and print the map if you can.

  2. Install the MapRun app on your phone.

  3. In the app choose Select Event, then UK, Suffolk, your area and the course you want.

  4. When you arrive, choose Go to Start, walk to the start location and wait for the bleep.

  5. Plan your route from control to control and finish at the finish control. Your phone bleeps or buzzes at each control.

  6. Your results and times appear at the end and upload automatically.

If you are in the right place but there is no bleep, walk around a little. GPS accuracy varies.

Course types

  • Linear visit the controls in order and choose your own route.

  • Timed run route a simpler linear course with no route choice, good for beginners.

  • Scatter visit all the controls in any order.

  • Score collect as many points as you can within a time limit. Going over the limit costs penalty points.

Staying safe

  • Use only public roads, paths and open spaces, and take care at road crossings.

  • Under 16s should be accompanied by an adult in urban areas.

  • Follow any out-of-bounds or crossing instructions.

  • You take part at your own risk, as British Orienteering insurance covers organised events only.

  • Tell someone where you are going and follow the British Orienteering Code of Conduct.

Help and guides

  • MapRun quick guide

  • British Orienteering MapRun pictorial guide (PDF)

  • Missed a control that your route shows you were near? Contact Sarah Mansel, our MapRun coordinator, at maprun@suffoc.co.uk.
kit:
SUFFOC members can purchase short and long sleeve running tops, vests and jackets supplied by Bryzos.

Fleeces, sweatshirts, hoodies, T-Shirts, polo shirts and wooly hats are also available.

Club orders for kit are put together at intervals, when there is enough demand.

If you're interested in a future order, please contact our Club Captain, Gareth Radcliffe, to register your interest and for further details.
